name: Windows PMTU Black Hole Detection Disabled
description: Ensures EnablePMTUBHDetect is disabled (0) to prevent inconsistent path MTU discovery behavior that can degrade network reliability. Required Windows permission: LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnablePMTUBHDetect via delegated permission.

remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnablePMTUBHDetect /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnablePMTUBHDetect
